intro.text: One of the ten Heralds of the Almighty and patron of the Order of Edgedancers.
One of the ten Heralds of the Almighty, called the Herald of Healing and patron of the Order of Edgedancers.

items.text: Vedel was born on Alaswha and became queen of a city-state there. She was visiting Odium's empire when Ashyn was scoured; her people appear to have died, but she escaped to Roshar through an Elsegate and became a skilled healer.
On Roshar, Vedel trained surgeons ahead of each coming Desolation, and once the Knights Radiant were founded she became patron of the Edgedancers.
At the Last Desolation, Vedel and the other Heralds decided to give up the Oathpact and leave Taln alone on Braize.

appearance.text: To modern Rosharans Vedel looks Alethi or Veden, though paler than most; some take her for a Horneater. Her hair is long and dark, with a slight curl.
